description.value: Founded in 1986 as Village Market by Pete and Jo-Anne Pimlott, this family-owned 26,000-square-foot store is the only grocery store serving Lake Cowichan's 3,000 year-round residents, along with a large seasonal influx of campers, hikers, and lake visitors. The store includes a bakery, deli, health foods department, fresh floral, and a café with wireless internet. A well-stocked outdoor section appears seasonally to serve the area's active recreation community.
